turn_history.text: Let's imagine you and a friend are standing on opposite sides of a street. If you both look at a street sign, are the angles you form with the sign the same? Think about how this real-world situation relates to the angles in the diagram with Tom and Katie.

This relationship helps us understand why angles \( p \) and \( q \) are not always equal, even when they are alternate.
